text: Hey! Where’re you going?!\nWe need your help over here![VAR 0114(0005)]
You two...\nWhat in the world are you doing?[VAR 0114(000B)]

What?! Come off it, Sonia!
You must’ve seen that, right?!\c
Those...those...sword and shield Pokémon!
They were right in front of us!\c
But then they disappeared into the forest...[VAR 0114(0005)]
Hop, you sure you haven’t lost the plot?\nThere was no one here but the two of you...[VAR 0114(000B)]
Wha...\nThen were those just...illusions or something?[VAR 0114(0005)]

Listen! I dug into some literature from other
regions, and I finally found something!\c
Mentions of the sword Pokémon, Zacian,
and the shield Pokémon, called Zamazenta.\c
The writings said that those two Pokémon were
born somewhere beyond the Slumbering Weald
sometime long, long ago.[VAR 0114(000B)]
Did they really?\nTa, Sonia. Thanks for digging into it.[VAR 0114(0005)]

Even if it is just an illusion or whatever, we did
manage to find that Pokémon again...\c
Maybe the sword and the shield that those two
used to carry are still here, too![VAR 0114(0005)]

Zacian and Zamazenta...\c
They may have been sleeping in the Slumbering
Weald right next to your hometown all this time.\c
Perhaps that’s why no one has entered the
deepest parts of these woods for so long...[VAR 0114(000B)]
